answer: The data was collected from conversational dialogs with workers on the crowdsourcing platform CrowdFlower [unit 1]. These dialogs were annotated by expert annotators and published under Creative Commons 4.0 BY-SA license on Lindat [unit 1].

The average length of dialog is not explicitly stated in the text. However, the dataset contains 1900 dialogs and 8533 turns. Given this, we can estimate the average number of turns per dialog as follows:

[turns per dialog | 8533 / 1900 ≈ 4.49]
